servers.description: Reserved documentation placeholder; replace with configured TLS endpoint.

204.description: No eligible assignment; long poll timed out

200.description: SSE frames: id is the persisted per-Run seq; data is an EventEnvelope JSON. Heartbeats carry no id. Last-Event-ID and after cannot conflict.
Authorized complete content; recheck permission and revoke active stream within policy deadline.

204.description: Bytes received; completion and hash verification still required.

200.description: Public, TLS-protected OIDC issuer/client discovery; the desktop must use PKCE and never an embedded login.

PlatformAccessToken.description: OIDC Access Token for the configured API audience; not an ID Token.

RunnerMTLS.description: Enrolled, scoped Runner certificate; not a user or guest identity.
